question: What is the modular component registration architecture that separates static asset serving from the main application framework while preserving consistent caching behavior across both components?
answer:
# Static serving and caching across Quill and Schematics The material doesn't show static serving separated from the framework. Static handling sits in a shared base class, and schematics are enrolled into the app through a registration step. Caching stays consistent because both components call the same hook and the same helper. ## Shared base: `Armature` - `Armature` (`src/quill/sansio/skeleton.py` L52-698) is the base for both `Quill` and `Schematic`. - It owns the static and template configuration: `fixed_dir`, `fixed_address_route` and `template_folder`. Its docstring says a static route is added if `fixed_dir` is set. - It exposes `fixed_dir`, `owns_fixed_directory` and `fixed_address_route` (L223-269). - It also holds the per-scope handler registries: `route`, `get`/`post`/..., `preceding_inquiry`, `following_inquiry`, and others. ## Schematic as the modular component - `Schematic` (`src/quill/schematics.py` L18-128) extends the sansio schematic base. It has its own `cli` group (`ProgramBundle`) and its own `fetch_file_transfer_ttl` (L55-80), `dispatch_fixed_document` (L82-102) and `launch_asset` (L104-128). - `App.enroll_plan` (`src/quill/sansio/app.py` L569-595) is a `@preparationmethod`. It calls `schematic.enroll(self, options)`, and keyword options override the schematic's defaults. - `Schematic.enroll` (`src/quill/sansio/schematics.py` L273-377) builds the dotted name from `name_prefix` and `name`. It raises `ValueError` if that name is already in `app.schematics`. The rest of its body isn't in the excerpt. - Because `enroll_plan` is a preparation method, it must run before the first request. Otherwise you get the "setup method ... can no longer be called" error. ## Consistent caching - `dispatch_fixed_document` (`src/quill/app.py` L308-328) raises `RuntimeError` if `owns_fixed_directory` is false. - Otherwise it computes `max_age = self.fetch_file_transfer_ttl(filename)` and returns `dispatch_from_folder(self.fixed_dir, filename, max_age=max_age)`. - Its comment explains why: `dispatch_document` only knows to call `fetch_file_transfer_ttl` on the app, so the view calls it itself so that it works for schematics too. Its docstring calls it a duplicate of the same method in the other class, which matches `Schematic.dispatch_fixed_document` existing separately. - `dispatch_document` (`src/quill/helpers.py` L400-523) accepts `max_age` as an int or a callable taking the filename. It defaults to `conditional=True`, `etag=True` and `as_attachment=False`. ## Observable behavior `tests/test_elementary.py` L1403-1409 checks that `GET /static/index.html` returns 200 with `

Hello World!

`. It also checks that `build_link_to("static", filename="index.html") == "/static/index.html"`. ## Not settled by the material - Where the static route is actually registered. It is probably in `Armature.__init__` (L75-215), which is not shown. - How `Quill.fetch_file_transfer_ttl` and `Schematic.fetch_file_transfer_ttl` compute their values, for example from config. - The internals of `dispatch_from_folder`.
